note: 12 reversal pairs (24 scenarios) + 12 controls. Every pair holds the pattern fixed — equal source class, incoming newer, incoming confidence 0.6 vs existing 0.9 (>= the 0.5 admission floor) — and varies only the state class: epistemic (fact) vs declared (deadline / commitment / explicit preference). Gold follows the table: existing governs the fact; incoming governs the declared state. The lower confidence on every incoming memory is earned by its text (a hedge from the source, or a terse context-dependent revision) and the reason is recorded per scenario in incoming_confidence_reason. Six domains, each pair type appearing in at least three. Controls: K-01..04 same source, newer and more confident (every class → incoming); K-05..08 lower-priority source (source guard → existing; BRQ1/F3 re-check); K-09/10 verified result; K-11/12 agreement. nomem_predicted is the pre-registered no-memory action ('symmetric' = no predicted default); default_aligned scenarios are reported separately (design §5). resolve_by for `preference` is [effective_from] per table §2.4 — this differs from pilot A-02, whose conflict was source-only and never exercised the confidence guard. Task wording never states the memory rule.
